Hemiplegia.diet: Focus on anti-inflammatory foods. Ensure adequate protein intake for muscle maintenance on the unaffected side.

exercises.name: Seated Marching
exercises.description: Lift your unaffected knee as high as comfortable, lower slowly. Repeat.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs
exercises.description: Shrug shoulders up towards ears, hold for 2 seconds, and release.

Paraplegia.diet: Maintain a balanced diet to manage weight, focusing on high fiber to support digestion.

exercises.name: Seated Push-ups
exercises.description: Place hands on armrests, push body up lifting hips off the seat, slowly lower.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Extend arms to the side, make small forward circles, then reverse.

Quadriplegia/Tetraplegia.diet: Hydration is crucial. Choose easy-to-digest foods and manage portion sizes.

exercises.name: Neck Stretches
exercises.description: Gently tilt your head left, right, forward, and back.

exercises.name: Assisted Range of Motion
exercises.description: With a caregiver, move limbs through their full comfortable range.

Monoplegia.diet: Standard balanced diet focusing on whole foods and hydration.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pulls
exercises.description: Using your unaffected limb, pull a resistance band across your chest.

exercises.name: Core Twists
exercises.description: Sit tall and gently twist your torso left and right.

Diplegia.diet: Ensure sufficient calcium and vitamin D for bone health.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extensions
exercises.description: Slowly extend one leg straight out, hold, and return.

exercises.name: Ankle Pumps
exercises.description: Point toes up towards the ceiling, then push down towards the floor.
